# Shri Vishwavedhika Ayurvedic Clinic & Garbhsanskar, Panchkarma Centre

> Premium classical Ayurvedic medical clinic and Panchakarma centre in Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra. Directed by Chief Ayurvedic Physician Dr. Manjiri Musmade (B.A.M.S., PGFC in Panchakarma, MUHS Nashik). Specializing in authentic five-fold Panchakarma bio-purification, Vedic Garbha Sanskar antenatal care, non-surgical spine and sciatica relief (Kati Basti), knee osteoarthritis rehabilitation (Janu Basti), cervical spondylosis care (Manya Basti), and Ayurvedic neurological stroke recovery.

## Transparent Treatment Costs & Pricing Architecture
- **Initial Nadi Pariksha & Clinical Doctor Consultation:** ₹500 – ₹800 (includes Ashtavidha Pariksha pulse examination, Prakriti dosha diagnosis, and custom dietary roadmap).

- **Shirodhara / Takradhara Therapy:** ₹1,200 – ₹2,500 per sitting; 5 to 7 session stress & insomnia packages: ₹9,000 – ₹15,000.

- **Garbha Sanskar Antenatal Modules:** ₹1,500 – ₹2,500 per module; Complete 9-month pregnancy trimester package: ₹8,000 – ₹18,000.
- **Specialized Para-Surgical & Classical Interventions:**
  - Uttar Basti (Tubal Blockage & Infertility): ₹2,000 – ₹3,500 per sitting

   Authentic 5-fold bio-purification (Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, Raktamokshana) for deep metabolic toxin (Ama) eradication.
2. **Kati Basti (Spine & Sciatica Care):** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/kati-basti-treatment-in-kharadi
   Non-surgical localized warm medicated oil reservoir therapy for slip disc, lumbar spondylosis, and sciatic nerve pain.
3. **Janu Basti (Knee Joint Care):** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/janu-basti-treatment-in-kharadi
   Classical herbal oil retention therapy for knee osteoarthritis, crepitus, cartilage erosion, and avoiding knee replacement surgery.
4. **Manya Basti (Cervical & Neck Care):** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/manya-basti-treatment-in-kharadi
   Targeted cervical spine oil pooling for cervical spondylosis, neck stiffness, brachial radiculopathy, and tech neck syndrome.
5. **Shirodhara Treatment:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/shirodhara-treatment-in-kharadi
   Rhythmic warm herbal oil stream over the forehead (Ajna chakra) for clinical insomnia, work stress, anxiety, and migraines.
6. **Garbha Sanskar Program:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/garbha-sanskar-in-kharadi

8. **Uttar Basti Treatment:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/uttar-basti-treatment-in-kharadi

9. **Stroke Rehabilitation (Pakshaghata):** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/stroke-rehabilitation-in-kharadi
   Ayurvedic neuro-restorative protocol combining Njavarakizhi, Shirodhara, and Medhya Rasayanas for paralysis and hemiplegia recovery.
10. **Vamana Therapy:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/vamana-therapy-in-kharadi
    Therapeutic medicated emesis for chronic asthma, allergic bronchitis, sinusitis, and severe Kapha imbalances.
11. **Virechana Therapy:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/virechana-therapy-in-kharadi

    Medicated oil and herbal decoction enemas (Yoga, Kala, and Karma Basti regimens) addressing the master dosha Vata.
13. **Nasya Therapy:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/nasya-therapy-in-kharadi
    Cranial administration of medicated herbal drops (Kshirabala / Anu Taila) for sinusitis, migraine, cervical stiffness, and hair fall.
14. **Raktamokshana Treatment:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/raktamokshana-treatment-in-kharadi
    Classical blood purification using sterile surgical techniques and medical leeches for localized toxic Pitta and Rakta diseases.
15. **Agnikarma Treatment:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/agnikarma-treatment-in-kharadi
    Fast-acting micro-thermal cautery using a Panchadhatu Shalaka for instant relief in heel spurs, plantar fasciitis, and tennis elbow.

17. **Takradhara & Lepa Therapy:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/takradhara-treatment-in-kharadi
    Cooling medicated buttermilk stream and classical herbal paste application for psoriasis, eczema, alopecia areata, and Pitta burnout.
18. **Patra Pinda Sweda (Elakizhi):** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/patra-pinda-sweda-in-kharadi
    Herbal bolus potli massage with medicinal leaves (Nirgundi, Eranda, Arka) fried in herbal oils for joint stiffness and arthritis.
19. **Abhyanga & Swedana:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/abhyanga-and-swedana-in-kharadi

20. **Netra Tarpana Eye Care:** https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/netra-tarpana-treatment-in-kharadi
    Medicated herbal ghee pooling over the ocular orbits for computer vision syndrome, dry eyes, eye fatigue, and refractive strain.
